# FG-REVIEW-0001

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 409 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_second_open_merge_request_for_the_same_branches_is_refused` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: 同じブランチどうしの開いているマージリクエストがすでにあります。既存のマージリクエストを使ってください。
- en: An open merge request for the same source and target branches already exists. Use the existing merge request.
- id: Merge request terbuka untuk branch sumber dan tujuan yang sama sudah ada. Gunakan merge request yang sudah ada.

## 原因 (cause)

A merge request was to be opened (`POST /api/v1/projects/{id}/merge-requests`), reopened (`POST …/merge-requests/{iid}/reopen`) or retargeted (`PATCH …/merge-requests/{iid}` with `target_branch`) while another merge request of the same project with the same source and target branch is open (ADR-0024 §1: at most one open merge request per (project, source, target)). forge_db::review checks it under the project row lock; the partial unique index merge_requests_one_open is the database backstop. Nothing was written.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `reason=open_exists` (the check under the lock, with `existing_iid`) or `reason=unique_index` (the backstop), `project_id` and `action` (`merge_request.opened` / `merge_request.reopened` / `merge_request.updated`); branch names are not logged. List the open merge requests with `GET /api/v1/projects/{id}/merge-requests?state=open` (`gstn mr list --project ID`). The event also carries `user_id` (who asked).

## 対処 (fix)

Use (or close) the existing open merge request for those branches; then open or reopen the other one.
